meta.title: Configurable Multi-Level Approval Workflow: refused for a user without the Tenant Admin role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Tenant Admin role and as a Tenant Admin in the same tenant
Open and configure Configurable Multi-Level Approval Workflow with multi-level approval chains per module and value band
Observe and compare whether the workflow action is refused, absent, or available for each role
Record tenant RBAC configuration if the action is intentionally granted to additional roles
